scope: defines required m-of-n upgrade path before experimental promotion can become possible
binding_rule: This template has zero authority until instantiated as a signed rotation receipt and indexed in _truth/receipts/index.json.
required_before: epoch freeze based on experimental receipts
post_activation_rules: After activation_timestamp, validators must reject bootstrap signatures for experimental promotion.
Experimental promotion requires signatures satisfying the indexed m-of-n keyset.
Old bootstrap keys remain valid only for receipts issued before rotation effective timestamp and within bootstrap allowed_scope.
Any m-of-n rotation must be indexed before it has canonical effect.
